summary: Ryman Hospitality Properties filed an 8-K reporting entry into an indenture for $700 million aggregate principal of 6.250% Senior Notes due 2035. The notes are guaranteed by the company and certain subsidiaries, with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. Proceeds will fund part of the ~$1.38 billion Grande Lakes Acquisition in Orlando, Florida, alongside a previously closed common stock offering and cash. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, structurally subordinated to secured debt. A special mandatory redemption applies if the acquisition fails. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
